title: Bounded constructibility reflected by finite coefficient comparison
statement: For a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, a finite coefficient extension stage n, and a finite-type D.k-scheme T, let C be a bounded-below etale derived object. If its canonical finite-coefficient intrinsic pro-etale comparison has finite homology support and constructible cohomology sheaves, then C is bounded constructible on the etale site.

source.place: Tags 099T and 09AK; constructibility component of lem-sf-bounded-below-ctf-reflection

proof.text: Unpack finite homology support and choose lower and upper bounds; their minimum and maximum give an ordered interval, including the zero-complex case. Combine this interval with the degreewise intrinsic constructibility hypothesis.

Apply the finite-ring constructible-derived-origin essential-image criterion to obtain a bounded constructible etale object L and an isomorphism from its intrinsic comparison to the comparison of C. Use the canonical derived composition isomorphism to rewrite this as an isomorphism after the fixed-coefficient comparison.

Full faithfulness of the comparison on bounded-below complexes lifts the isomorphism and its inverse to maps between L and C. Injectivity on endomorphisms proves that the maps are inverse, yielding L ≅ C. Transport constructible cohomology and the finite vanishing interval across this isomorphism.
